findings.where: 'What you can actually create' cards 1 and 3, image links
findings.evidence: dom-1440.json: <a href="/cinematic-studio?quickstart=1"> and <a href="/ai-design"> wrapping the before/after images have accessible name 'BEFORE AFTER' (taken from the corner badges); the images inside carry alt text but the badge text wins. Out of context two links both say 'BEFORE AFTER' and go to different studios.
findings.after: aria-hidden="true" on the BEFORE/AFTER badges and aria-label="Restore and enhance old photos: open AI Design" on the link, or make the image link tabindex=-1 since 'Open AI Design' duplicates it
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context) and 2.5.3 Label in Name.

findings.evidence: focus.json stop 0 is the fixed bottom-right 'Send feedback' bug button (x1380 y832), before the logo and nav. There is no skip link and no <main> (sweep).
findings.before: Floating feedback button first in DOM order
findings.after: Move the feedback button to the end of the body; add Skip to content first and wrap content in
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.3 Focus Order: the first stop is a bottom-corner utility, not the page start.

findings.where: 'Thumbnails' section, three rows of cover images
findings.evidence: dom-1440.json: div.flex.gap-3 rows run CSS animations 'marquee' 28s, 'marquee-reverse' 32s and 'marquee' 26s continuously; no pause control visible in tiles.
findings.after: Add a pause button (and pause on hover/focus), and set animation: none under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide: auto-moving content longer than 5 seconds needs a pause.

findings.evidence: focus.json: an <audio controls> element (stops at x624 y2170) sits inside the card <a href="/audio-studio"> (stop at x536 y2046). Interactive content nested in a link: activating the player can follow the link, and the audio stop appears twice in the tab order.
findings.after: Make the card a <div> with the heading as the link (stretched-link pattern) so the audio player is a sibling, not a descendant
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value and 2.1.1 Keyboard: nested interactive controls are not reliably operable.

findings.where: three 'How to?' links on the outcome cards
findings.evidence: Three links named 'How to?' go to three different blog posts (/blog/animate-old-photos..., /blog/character-styles..., /blog/restore-colorize...).
findings.after: How to animate an old photo or append visually hidden context
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.4 Link Purpose; identical names for different targets fail 2.4.9 and confuse links lists.

findings.where: hero tagline 'AI VIDEO & CHARACTER STUDIO — NO EXPERIENCE NEEDED' (tile 1440-00)
findings.evidence: Caps tagline tracked so tight the words touch ('AIVIDEO&CHARACTERSTUDIO—NOEXPERIENCENEEDED' as rendered at 1440), mid-grey on a photo; legibility fails by eye even where contrast may pass.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.12 Text Spacing intent and 1.4.3 readability; draft card A11-171 covers muted text over photos.

strengths: Content images have descriptive alt ('Damaged vintage photograph before restoration', 'Restored and colorized vintage photograph'); the marquee covers use alt="" as decoration.
Carousel controls are named ('Previous slide', 'Next slide', 'Show Veo 3.1').
